---
title: "Billboard Graphic"
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages(library(tidyverse))
```

```{r}
data("billboard", package = "tidyr")

billboard_long <- billboard |>
  pivot_longer(cols = starts_with("wk"),
               names_to = "week",
               values_to = "rank",
               values_drop_na = TRUE) |>
  mutate(week = as.integer(gsub("wk", "", week)))

top_songs <- billboard_long |>
  group_by(artist, track) |>
  summarize(weeks = n(), peak = min(rank), .groups = "drop") |>
  arrange(peak, desc(weeks)) |>
  slice(1:5)

billboard_long |>
  filter(track %in% top_songs$track) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = week, y = rank, color = track)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_y_reverse() +
  labs(title = "Top 5 Billboard Songs by Peak Rank",
       x = "Week", y = "Rank", color = "Track") +
  theme_minimal()
```
